about: The non-regression lock: OUR build of the four binaries as the gate (make ide) makes it -- not the original files, which no image equals yet byte for byte. `smsg lock --check` fails on any difference; a commit that changes this file carries a `Lock-Update: <reason>` trailer. CONTRIBUTING.md says how to verify a build against it.
object_digest: code digest: per section name, the sorted sha256s of its sections, each over its name, characteristics, size, bytes and relocations (offset, type, and the target as the target section's bytes plus the symbol value, or external); no .debug$ section, symbol name, label number, line record, file pointer or section order; plus the sorted common-symbol sizes. A .res file: the sha256 of its bytes
